t: In front of you is the Diana, Princess of Wales Memorial Fountain in Hyde Park. It is a memorial to Diana, who died in a car crash in 1997, and it was designed to express her spirit and her love of children. Kathryn Gustafson, an American landscape architect, made it. She is known for sculptural forms shaped from earth, grass, stone and water, and her other work includes gardens and a city square in France.
